_about: Surge XT presets that passed screening (not silent, peak<4, rms>-50 dB). path is relative to the Surge data dir; load with surge_render.find_patch(path) or str(DATA/(path+".fxp")). gain_db brings the test phrase to -18 dBFS RMS. feats: cen = spectral centroid Hz, side = stereo width ratio, sus = level at 350 ms vs 50 ms (sustain), tail = level 0.3 s after release. Pick by seed and keep a used-set across videos so presets do not repeat.
